items.title: 6.4.2 Use Cases of Blockchain Technology (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain technology ke istemal cryptocurrency se kahin zyada hain. Kuch aham istemal (use cases) yeh hain:

items: Cryptocurrencies: Bitcoin aur Ethereum jaisi cryptocurrencies ki underlying technology (jis par woh chalti hain) blockchain hai. Is se intermediaries (beech wale, jaise bank) ke baghair mehfooz aur decentralized digital transactions mumkin hoti hain.

Supply Chain Management: blockchain se maal ki supply chain (banane wale se khareedar tak ka safar) mein harkat ka record aur verification (jaanch kar pakka karna) ki ja sakti hai. Yeh transparency (sab kuch sab ko saaf nazar aana) dhoke se bachati, ghaltiyan kam karti aur products ke asli hone ka yaqeen dilati hai.

Healthcare: healthcare (sehat) ke field mein blockchain mareezon ke records mehfooz rakh sakta, medical data sambhal sakta, aur yaqeeni bana sakta hai ke sensitive (naazuk, jise chhupa kar rakhna zaroori ho) maloomat tak sirf authorised (ijazat wale) log pohanchein.

Voting Systems: blockchain se mehfooz aur transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) voting systems banaye ja sakte hain jin mein vote sahi record aur gine jayein aur election mein dhandli (fraud) ka khatra kam ho.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Blockchain technology ko aksar aise digital ledger ya notebook se compare kiya jata hai jise network mein sab dekh sakte aur jis par sab agree karte hain. Ek dafa page jur jaye to badla nahi ja sakta, is liye sab ke paas events (hone wali baaton) ka ek hi record hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain mein distributed ledger ka aham faida kya hai (exercise MCQ 4)? Distributed ledger istemal karne ka maqsad kya hai (exercise MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 4: (c) decentralized verification ki wajah se zyada transparency aur hifazat. MCQ 7: (b) kai participants ko data mehfooz aur transparent tareeqe se share aur verify karne dena. (Kitab ki answer key MCQ 4 ka (b) aur MCQ 7 ka (c) deti hai; dono ghalat hain, kyunke (b) 'record aasani se badalna' aur (c) 'participants kam karna' blockchain ke ulat hain.)

items: Istemal: cryptocurrencies, supply chain, healthcare, voting.
Ek dafa jura record badla nahi ja sakta; sab ke paas ek hi record.
